info.title: Quad API
info.description: School, parent and console routes. Errors are `{ code, message, fields? }`.

503.description: A dependency is down; the body names it

post.summary: SES bounce and complaint events from SNS (signature version 2, pinned topic)

get.summary: The signed-in person, their school and brand, other schools, banners and greeting

patch.summary: Change your name, theme or locale in this school (needs X-CSRF-Token)

get.summary: What you can do in this school: permission keys, every staff page and how much of it opens, your home page and any role preview

post.summary: Preview the staff portal as a role, read-only (users.manage; a role for own classes needs a sample person; needs X-CSRF-Token)

delete.summary: End the role preview: back to your own view (needs X-CSRF-Token)
Sign one of your devices out (needs X-CSRF-Token)

post.summary: Set up an authenticator: without a code it starts one, with its code it confirms it and gives the recovery codes (needs X-CSRF-Token)

200.description: The otpauth URI, or the recovery codes

post.summary: Sign in with email and password; sets the session cookies and says what comes next
Check the authenticator or recovery code at the two-step step (needs X-CSRF-Token)

get.summary: The schools you can open (Choose a school, Switch school)

post.summary: Open one of your schools. Staff: rotates the session cookie (needs X-CSRF-Token). Parent app: the select_school token gets both tokens; a school token switches and gets only the new access token (the refresh token stays)

200.description: Parent app (bearer): the tokens for the school

204.description: Staff (cookie): signed in to the school

post.summary: Sign out: the staff session for every school (needs X-CSRF-Token), or the parent app’s token family on this device
Send a 6-digit sign-in code to a mobile number or email (the same answer whether or not it is known)

202.description: A code is on its way; it works for 10 minutes

post.summary: Check the code: signs in to your one school, asks you to choose among several, or says you were not found
Swap the refresh token for a new pair; an old refresh token signs the device out everywhere it was copied

200.description: The new access and refresh tokens

post.summary: Email a password reset link (the same answer whether or not the account exists)

202.description: If the account exists, a reset link is on its way

post.summary: Set a new password with a reset link; signs out every device
Console: sign in with email and password; sets the console cookies and asks for the authenticator code (or to set one up)
Console, first sign-in: a new authenticator secret and its otpauth URI, shown once (needs X-CSRF-Token)
Console: check the authenticator code (or the first code of a new one) and open the console on a new cookie (needs X-CSRF-Token)
Console: sign out this browser and clear the console cookies (needs X-CSRF-Token)

get.summary: Console: the signed-in Quad staff member’s name and role
